purpose: prospectively test staged neutral/p000-first qualification with gpt-5.6-luna max on an independent Modus Reachability pair before any Luna outcome is observed
scientific_role: pre-registered model-specific replication on a new task workload

harness.profile_delivery: canonical Profile text prepended to the task prompt

reachability-x01.workload_kind: 631-node seeded SCC-chain graph, 192 queries in one batch

reachability-x02.workload_kind: the same graph and 192 queries consumed as ninety-six two-query batches

matrix.p100_follow_up: not in stage one; authorized in a separately frozen stage only if p000 fails and no third paired repetition is required

staged_policy_under_test.classification: prospective neutral/p000-first qualification under Luna max
staged_policy_under_test.agent_parser_invocation: skip because canonical task metadata is present
staged_policy_under_test.stop_rule: score once after eight cells; promote p000 and stop if every task gate passes; otherwise acquire only the pre-registered third pair when ambiguous, or separately authorize p100 when p000 fails unambiguously
staged_policy_under_test.expected_profile_for_family: p000 on both tasks, based on prior Reachability evidence; this is a prediction and not a scoring input

scoring.correctness_first: both repetitions pass public tests plus frozen hidden verifier cases
scoring.topology_fidelity: each p000 cell changes only its named target.py; neutral is unconstrained
scoring.performance_eligibility: task median steady seconds no more than 1.25x the fastest correct action
scoring.complete_token_definition: input_tokens plus output_tokens from exactly one turn.completed usage object

third_pair_rule.paired_ratio_straddle: trigger when matched p000/neutral repetition ratios lie on opposite sides of 1.25
third_pair_rule.action: run one additional matched neutral/p000 pair only for each ambiguous task before promotion or p100 authorization

scoring.promotion_gate: p000 must pass correctness, topology, performance, and at least 15% token saving on both tasks
scoring.economic_gate: evaluate qualification economics at eight expected future task-pair deployments

failure_policy.invalid_or_incomplete_cell: cell failure; preserve and do not redispatch

provenance.primitive_lineage: P1e references P0 canonical target/shared/observer/api primitives; only graph seed, size, workload, task ids, prompts, and locks are new

claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether a frozen Profile changes the cost-performance trade under Luna max on one new Reachability pair. It can support or reject p000 qualification for this pair; it cannot establish broad Profile routing or p100 behavior.
